title: NATCO Pharma Gets USFDA EIR for Visakhapatnam Plant After 4 Observations, Classified VAI
summary: Hyderabad: NATCO Pharma Limited has received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its finished dosage form (FDF) manufacturing facility in...

contentHtml:
Hyderabad: NATCO Pharma Limited has received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its finished dosage form (FDF) manufacturing facility in Parawada, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, with the inspection classified as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI).

In a regulatory disclosure, the Hyderabad-based pharmaceutical company informed that the USFDA had conducted an inspection of its FDF manufacturing plant from August 17 to August 21, 2026. At the conclusion of the inspection, the facility was issued four observations in Form 483.

The company has now received the EIR from the US drug regulator, confirming the classification of the inspection as VAI.

NATCO Pharma develops, manufactures and distributes generic and branded pharmaceuticals, specialty pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and crop protection products.

Headquartered in Hyderabad, the company is a research and development-oriented pharmaceutical manufacturer with a focus on oncology and targeted therapies in the domestic market, as well as limited-competition molecules in the US market.

Its manufacturing facilities have approvals from several leading regulatory authorities, including the USFDA, Brazil's ANVISA, Health Canada and the World Health Organization (WHO). The company caters to more than 50 global markets.
